entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help you with that. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
Thank you, Amelia. I see your order for the Velo-Carbon cycling shoes delivered on January 5th. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're just terrible. I went for one ride and got horrible blisters on my heel. The fit is completely off.

I'm very sorry to hear that. A proper fit is essential, and getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Did you get a chance to set up your cleats, or was the discomfort immediate?
I've been riding for a decade. I know how to set up cleats. The shoes are the problem. I want a refund.

Of course, I understand. Not a problem at all. I see you received them just 8 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes. I can definitely process a full refund for you.

I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. And because you're a VIP member with us, Amelia, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and added a $20 credit to your account for the trouble. Hopefully, you can use that towards a different pair that will be a better fit.
It's on its way to your email right now. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do hope we can find a better product for you in the future. Have a good day.
